response.original_title: Mrs. GREEN APPLE ゼンジン未到とイ/ミュータブル〜間奏編〜 LIVE VIEWING
response.overview: Theatrical live viewing of the 5 July 2026 final of Mrs. GREEN APPLE's stadium tour "ZENJIN MITO TO IM/MUTABLE ~Interlude~," recorded at Tokyo's MUFG Stadium (Japan National Stadium). Motoki Ohmori, Hiroto Wakai, and Ryoka Fujisawa close a six-date tour that also played Osaka's Yanmar Stadium Nagai.
